trial_court: IIIrd Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Indore (HMA No.9/2019)
facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife challenged the order rejecting her application for maintenance under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The income of the wife cannot operate as a bar for awarding maintenance to her from her husband.
legal_principles.held: It has been held that the income of the wife cannot operate as a bar for awarding maintenance to her from her husband.
cited_cases: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and Ors., (2020) Cri.A No.730/2020
Sunita Kachwaha and Ors. Vs. Anil Kachwaha, AIR 2015 SC 554
M.P. Singh Bargoti Vs. State of M.P. & Anr., AIR 2015 SC 556
Chaturbhuj Vs. Sita Bai, AIR 2008 SC 530
Kapildeo Mandal & Ors. Vs. State of Bihar, AIR 2008 SC 533

legal_principles.principle: The Court has to determine whether income of wife is sufficient to enable her to maintain herself in accordance with life style of her husband in the matrimonial house.
legal_principles.held: The Court has to determine whether income of wife is sufficient to enable her to maintain herself in accordance with life style of her husband in the matrimonial house.
cited_cases: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and Ors., (2020) Cri.A No.730/2020
Sunita Kachwaha and Ors. Vs. Anil Kachwaha, AIR 2015 SC 554
M.P. Singh Bargoti Vs. State of M.P. & Anr., AIR 2015 SC 556
Chaturbhuj Vs. Sita Bai, AIR 2008 SC 530
Kapildeo Mandal & Ors. Vs. State of Bihar, AIR 2008 SC 533

outcome.final_order: The court held that the trial court's decision was incorrect and that the respondent/husband should pay maintenance to the petitioner/wife.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet

advising on maintenance claims in family court proceedings
